title: Have pharmacy premises approved
what: Carry on a pharmacy business only on premises approved by the Pharmacy Council, with holders of financial interests registered.

laws.title: Health Practitioner Regulation (Adoption of National Law) Act 2009 (NSW)
laws.provisions: Health Practitioner Regulation National Law (NSW), Sch 5F cl 3(1)

sources.title: Health Practitioner Regulation (Adoption of National Law) Act 2009 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: Health Practitioner Regulation National Law (NSW), Sch 5F cl 3(1) (version of 2024-07-01)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on a pharmacy business unless— (a) the premises on which the pharmacy business is carried on are the subject of a current approval of the Council;
